column3: Four books cost £8 each. What is the total cost?
A train leaves at 2:35 p.m. and arrives 50 minutes later. When does it arrive?
A farmer has 96 eggs. He packs 12 in each box. How many boxes does he fill?
Mia saves £15 each week for 4 weeks. How much does she save?
A ribbon is 2 m long. Half is used. How much remains?
A class has 32 pupils. One-quarter wear glasses. How many wear glasses?
Sam buys a toy for £18 and a game for £24. How much does he spend?
A jug holds 1 litre. It contains 600 ml. How much more will fill it?
A bus has 54 passengers. At the next stop, 19 get off. How many remain?
A baker makes 9 trays of 8 cakes. How many cakes are made?
Tom reads 24 pages each day for 7 days. How many pages does he read?
A rope is 12 m long. It is cut into 3 equal pieces. How long is each piece?
A shop sells 125 balloons on Saturday and 175 on Sunday. How many balloons are sold?
There are 48 children. They stand in 6 equal rows. How many are in each row?
